nodes.description: Campaign-level graph, one level above sales-outreach.graph.json (which runs one prospect thread). This node scopes which market segment or account list the funnel targets this cycle.

Define the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and decision makers for this cycle. Ground it in real signal, not assumption: sales-outreach/ prospecting docs, TED_CONSTRUCTION_LEADS_PACK, regulatory-radar customer scoring, hilma-watch tender matches.

Choose the channel(s) to deliver content against the ICP: social content + social selling (LinkedIn via /lsj-publish), direct outreach (per-prospect via sales-outreach.graph.json), or event-led (conference/GITEX-style). Output is a channel plan, not content itself.

Sales-engagement-as-a-service: produce content, deliver it on the chosen channel(s), and capture opportunities. Content production for social routes through /blog-draft or /lsj-publish (both RED-gated on HIC approval before publish, per Non-Negotiable Rule 13). Direct-outreach opportunities route into sales-outreach.graph.json per prospect, entering at its START node — this is the handoff point between the campaign-level graph and the per-prospect graph.

An opportunity surfaced (inbound reply, meeting request, content engagement worth following up). Hands off to sales-outreach.graph.json (per-prospect chapter) for that specific contact; this campaign-level graph does not model the per-prospect thread itself.
Terminal for this cycle — ICP/segment deprioritized, revisit next planning cycle.
Terminal — cycle complete. Feeds the MGD/CRC north-star (/mgd-report) via whichever per-prospect threads it spawned.
